label: Remnant star cruiser
note: IP-neutral. Issue #327: a second Remnant star cruiser, the same ship as the home planet's (everything not listed here is remnant_cruiser.json's: its pads and parked ships, how Z docks you, the crew, the droids, the general, the escort). It holds station near the ringed giant's space station: where is the giant's 'belt_cruiser' landmark (content/core/planets/ringed_giant.json). It is not the story's: killing its general sets only its own flag (WorldState 'belt_cruiser_taken', saved with the world) and pays its own reward; the home cruiser, Oda's story, the port's love and the dark master (who waits only in the home cruiser's bay) are untouched. Once taken the locals crew it as they do the home one (remnant_cruiser.json's 'holders': the bay and the bridge, by your standing with them; his Remnant on the dark master's oath), and it is still there to fly to and walk round. Its escort meets you when you climb out of the station's sky flying for it (nose within approach.cone_deg of it, or already within dock.radius of it); leaving for another planet the other way meets nobody.

holo.note: The bridge's holo table shows the whole system this cruiser hangs in (CruiserHolo.setup_system): the ringed giant (radius metres on the table, lines of latitude and longitude bands apart), its ring from the planet's own body.ring (inner and outer in planet radii, its tilt) as a faint band with rocks rocks in it (rock_min and rock_max their sizes, ring_thick how far they scatter, seed their layout), and on their orbits round it the space station (a small model of it station_width long, at least station_over metres off the ball, a bead station_bead over it), this cruiser where it really is (heights squeezed by squeeze), and the giant's moon in its true direction at moon_at times the ball's radius (moon_min_radius to moon_max_radius big), its barracks pinned on top and its five outposts where they really are on it (moon_pin_scale: the pins' size). Who holds each: the station's barracks (its Remnant deck, Territory 'station_<landmark id>'), the cruiser (the Remnant's until its general dies, then empty), and the moon's outposts and barracks (Territory's 'lava_moon' front), coloured by owner_colors (and empty for the taken cruiser) and named under each label (lines.owners), recoloured and renamed live. Issue #838: the three skimmer outposts (Territory's 'belt' front, places 'station_<landmark id>') are pins on the giant under where they really are, coloured by who holds each like the moon's, and the station city's label counts them (lines.moon's format). It spins slowly (spin_deg_s) about the giant's up.
